text: 🇲🇽🌎 "Any agreement must guarantee Mexico’s wellbeing, our Constitution and our sovereignty." "We don’t want more tariffs — and we have among the lowest tariffs of any country." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera, Aug 28 2026 Washington has imposed 50% tariffs on Mexican steel and aluminum, 25% on cars and 10% on everything outside the USMCA. Sheinbaum’s answer: no panic — the economy “is doing very well.” Marcelo Ebrard stays in Washington to negotiate, but sovereignty is the fixed red line.

🔥🇲🇽 Mexico’s financial intelligence unit has frozen 8.6 billion pesos and blocked 24,622 accounts. "2,395 people added to the blocked list. 24,622 accounts immobilized. 8,670,814,057 pesos frozen." — Omar Reyes Colmenares, UIF director, Aug 28 2026 About a third of those accounts — 7,681 — trace directly to organized crime. The UIF now also tracks crypto transfers in real time. No tanks, no militarized “war”: the state is choking off the money.

🇲🇽✊ García Luna’s stolen millions will now build schools in Mexico’s poorest mountains. "We are reaching a kind of social justice — after everything we have witnessed." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera, Aug 28 2026 On Aug 25 Mexico recovered $5,805,693 USD from assets tied to Genaro García Luna — Felipe Calderón’s security chief, convicted in a US court of taking cartel bribes. Sheinbaum announced the money will fund schools in La Montaña de Guerrero, one of the country’s most neglected regions. The old regime’s corruption, redirected into classrooms.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Baja California Pulls In $1.743 Billion in Foreign Investment</u>

Nearshoring keeps landing where Washington won't admit it works: Baja California captured $1.743 billion in foreign direct investment in the first half of 2026 — up 8.1% year-on-year, good for 4th place nationally and 5% of all FDI into Mexico, per El Economista. Just five states, led by CDMX, Nuevo León and Edomex, drew 73.9% of the country's inflows.

🇲🇽👶 <u>ISSSTE Pours 112 Million Pesos Into Free Public Childcare</u>

While private daycare stays out of reach for millions, Mexico's ISSSTE is putting more than 112 million pesos into rebuilding, expanding and upgrading nine child-development centers — part of a public network of 114 EBDI where 21,000 kids get care, meals, preschool certification and psychoemotional support at no cost. Director Martí Batres frames them as dignified spaces where the youngest can grow, learn and play. (El Soberano)

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>FGR Raids Expose 4-Billion-Peso Fuel-Theft Ring — PAN Ex-Governor in the Net</u>

The FGR raided two Ingemar warehouses on Aug 26–27 and seized import permits and contracts documenting a "huachicol fiscal" network that moved 3.96 million liters of fuel and inflicted over 4 billion pesos in tax damage — 162 rail tankers, $1.386B in foreign-currency operations. Among the 25 people under investigation: PAN ex-governor of Baja California Ernesto Ruffo Appel. Prosecutor Ernestina Godoy says 96 pieces of evidence are already compiled. (Contralínea)

🇲🇽🏛️ <u>Sheinbaum Moves to Bar Dual Nationals From the Presidency</u>

Sheinbaum has sent Congress a constitutional reform requiring candidates for president, governor, or CDMX head of government to hold Mexican nationality only — renouncing any second passport before they register, with a 20-year residency floor and a ban on using a foreign passport or invoking another country's diplomatic protection while in office. It rewrites Articles 82, 116 and 122 to close the dual-nationality loophole in the highest offices of the state. (Contralínea)

🚨🇲🇽 <u>Pentagon Fires Battlefield Laser at "Mexican Cartel" Drones — Won't Say Where</u>

Mexico has drawn a hard line against foreign troops on its soil — so note what Washington just did: the US Army used its AMP-HEL high-energy laser to down three drones it labels "Mexican cartel" aircraft at the border on Aug 25–26, and when asked whether the shots crossed into Mexican airspace, NORTHCOM would only say they were fired "in coordination with all partners." Harfuch has been blunt: no foreign forces operate in Mexico. (La Jornada)

🔥🇲🇽 <u>García Luna's $727.9M Laundering Web Cracked Open</u>

Mexico's Financial Intelligence Unit just mapped how ex-security chief Genaro García Luna — already convicted in a New York court — triangulated up to $727.9M through Barbados and Miami with the Weinberg family between 2008 and 2018, skimming $403M in prison-system contracts alone. The first $5.8M, recovered from 12 Florida properties, hit the federal treasury on Aug 25 — and Sheinbaum says it goes straight to the Montaña de Guerrero.

‍BLOOMBERG: Trump presses Sheinbaum to stop migrants at the border August 27, 2026 | 🔴 📰 Rubio delivered the demand to Mexico's FM Velasco in Washington: contain migrants — including Mexican citizens — before they reach the border. Bloomberg names Stephen Miller as the man driving it. 🇲🇽 The paper concedes the catch in its own text: Mexican citizens have the constitutional right to move freely inside their own country, even from the poorest southern states. • pressure "led by National Security Advisor Stephen Miller" • a request to contain Mexican citizens "before they reach the border zone"
